title: Aid-Only last-feed skip still raises cattle alarm into Breaking
body:
Aid-Only LURE promises that the **last CAST / last feed skips +1 cattle alarm**. On the actual last CAST through the outer scent gate, cattle alarm still ticks (often 3→4 into **Breaking**) and **two cattle go missing**.

This is a plan-text vs play mismatch on the advertised Aid-Only win condition, not “the player failed a check.” Testers who took Aid-Only specifically to keep the herd intact still got the Breaking/missing-cattle ending.

**This wave** (Grok 4.6 low, `--seed-base 2100000000`, store `ai-runs/playtest/sessions-grok-stress-20260901`, build `b6daf7796ca09886805bd61002bf36675785b931`):

- 92 completed interviews; **30** named Aid-Only / last-feed skip
- **14** `bugs[]` rows (S2 7 / S1 2 / S0 5); 7 of the S2s are this last-CAST bump
- 29/30 of those sessions `would_replay: false`
- Typical `where`: Deep in the Byre, CAST through outer scent gate after Aid-Only LURE

Not a duplicate of ticket `fa0bcf219c803b70` (cattle alarm stays 0 while opening prose says the cattle already saw you). That is the **opening meter**. This is the **Aid-Only last-feed skip failing at the end of LURE**.

**What players said**

- “Aid-Only promised to skip the last feed's +1 cattle alarm; the final CAST still raised alarm to Breaking and two cattle were lost.”
- “Aid-Only said skip last-feed +1 cattle alarm; CAST still raised 3→4 into Breaking and two cattle missing.”
- “Last CAST still raising cattle alarm after Aid-Only promised that bump was skipped, locking two missing cattle.”

**Fix:** Honor the Aid-Only last-feed skip on the final CAST (do not add +1 cattle alarm), or change the plan copy so it does not promise a skip the engine will not grant. Journal, Cade’s plan review, and the actual last CAST must agree.

Sessions remain `operator_attested` (grok_cli / reference tier). They count toward bug corroboration, not experience metrics.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 low wave: 30/92 interviews named Aid-Only last-feed skip; 7 S2 last-CAST bugs.
